notes:
New ranking model A/B test, 14 days, 1.2M sessions.
- CTR +2.1% (95% CI +0.4% to +3.8%).
- Revenue per session +0.6%, not significant (p=0.21).
- Mobile +3.4% CTR; desktop flat (+0.1%, CI includes 0).
- Novelty effect not ruled out (effect was larger in week 1).
- Recommendation: ramp to 50%, not 100%, and re-check in 2 weeks.

Q3 churn analysis.
- Monthly churn rose from 4.1% (Q2) to 5.3% (Q3).
- The price change on Jul 1 and the competitor launch on Jul 9 both happened early in Q3; this analysis cannot separate the two.
- Annual-plan customers: churn unchanged (1.2%).
- Next step: survey ~200 churned users; results expected mid-November.

Pipeline bug double-counted ~3.2% of events from Aug 4 to Aug 11.
- DAU dashboards overstated by about 3% for that week.
- Fixed Aug 12; backfill completed Aug 14.
- Forecast model was retrained on Aug 10 with the bad data; impact on the forecast is still being assessed.
- No other models affected as far as we know.

Q4 demand forecast: 118k units, 80% interval 104k-131k.
- Last year's Q4 forecast error was 9%.
- Biggest uncertainty: holiday timing (Thanksgiving falls late this year).
- Supply asked for a single number; I recommend planning at 125k to cover the upper part of the interval.
- Will refresh the forecast Nov 15.

Fraud model v3 on September holdout.
- Precision 0.91 at recall 0.62 (v2: 0.88 at 0.55).
- False positive rate on new merchants is higher than v2 (2.1% vs 1.4%); we don't know why yet, investigating.
- Plan: ship to 10% of traffic Monday, guardrail on new-merchant FPR.
- Thanks to Priya for the feature work.

Onboarding survey.
- 412 responses, 18% response rate.
- 61% said onboarding was confusing.
- Respondents skew toward power users (70% weekly active vs ~35% overall), so this may not generalize.
- Top open-text themes: permissions setup, data import.
- Suggest 5 follow-up interviews with new users before redesigning.

notes:
Email reminder experiment.
- No detectable effect on 7-day retention: +0.2pp (95% CI -0.5pp to +0.9pp).
- Test was powered to detect a 1pp change.
- A small effect under 1pp is not ruled out.
- Recommend stopping the test and not shipping the reminder.

p95 latency spiked from 340ms to 910ms on Oct 3 starting 14:12 UTC.
- Spike began 14 minutes after the 13:58 config deploy.
- Traffic was also up 22% that hour.
- Leading hypothesis: the cache eviction policy change in the deploy. Not confirmed.
- Rollback scheduled for 16:00 UTC; will report whether latency recovers.
